entities.summary: Tryggvi Snær Hlinason is an Icelandic professional basketball player for Bilbao Basket of the Liga ACB. He began his career in his home country, competing with Þór Akureyri. Tryggvi is a regular member of the Icelandic national team, with experience at EuroBasket. In 2024 and 2025, he was named the Icelandic Male Basketball Player of the Year.
